title: GridView data-source attribution record
description: The repository-owned, per-source attribution GridView shows for third-party data it relies on (ADR 0019 decision 5; GridView_Provider_Evaluation.md §7.6.2). Attribution is held as data rather than hard-coded strings so a licensor-supplied copyright notice, warranty-disclaimer notice or creator designation can be added, and a source removed on the licensor's request (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 §3(a)(3)), without changing application code. The Flutter Acknowledgements screen renders this file; the edge API does not read it yet. Localized explanatory copy (status, modification and non-endorsement notices) lives in the application's localization files, never here.

version.description: Identifies the exact content of this record: every source entry and every field of each entry. Any change to that content, including adding or removing a source or changing a link, licence, notice or status, requires a new version, and a version is never reused for different content. `npm run validate:content` enforces the binding through a pinned content digest per version. This is the value a later SeasonSnapshotMetadata.attributionVersion will carry; nothing publishes it yet.

sources.description: One entry per licensor. Attribution is per source, never merged into one generic credit.

httpsUrl.description: An https URL with a host and no embedded credentials; the application refuses to open anything else.

sourceId.description: Stable key for the source within this record. Not shown to the reader.

name.description: The source's own name, shown as published by the source.

termsUrl.description: Link to the source's published terms of use, when it publishes any.

licenseTitle.description: Full licence title as the licence publishes it.

status.description: `dormant`: no GridView runtime retrieves data from this source yet, so the screen must not claim that live data from it is being served. `active`: GridView retrieves and serves data derived from it. Moving to `active` is an explicit activation decision, not a side effect of this file.

copyrightNotice.description: A copyright notice the licensor supplies, retained verbatim (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 §3(a)(1)(A)(ii)). `null` when none is supplied.

warrantyDisclaimerNotice.description: A notice referring to the licensor's disclaimer of warranties (§3(a)(1)(A)(iv)). `null` when none is supplied.

creatorDesignation.description: A creator identification the licensor requests (§3(a)(1)(A)(i)). `null` when none is requested; the source `name` is then the attribution.
